description: Privacy release migrations in apply order. Checked by scripts/release-preflight.mjs; regenerate with --write-manifest --from <version> and review the diff.

release_range.chosen_because: Runbook section 2 step 0a (20261103100000) is the first migration of the privacy release. Section 1's first unledgered file (20260915214000) is not used: the 71 files from 20260915214000 to 20261030120000 are already in production by catalog evidence but have no ledger rows, and 20260926155719 is ledgered after them, so a range starting there would always look like a gap and would list historical files as pending. Their ledger rows are a separate owner decision, and historical files must never be re-run.

generated.method: full local replay as role postgres (stub + every earlier migration), catalog snapshot before the range and after each release file. States, keyed by Postgres major (null = absent): functions = md5(pg_get_functiondef), owner, prosecdef, proconfig search_path and the normalized ACL (aclexplode grantee:privilege); policies = md5 of pg_policies qual/with_check/cmd+permissive+roles; tables = relrowsecurity, relforcerowsecurity, normalized ACL, every non-internal trigger (name|function|tgtype|tgenabled) and the full set of policy names; buckets = storage.buckets.public. expect_before = before the range, expect_steps[v] = after defining migration v, expect_after = after the whole range. States are never compared across majors; add another major with --merge-hashes.

known_unledgered_basis: Runbook section 1 / docs/migration-history-reconciliation.md section 3: these historical files are in production by catalog evidence (docs/migration-evidence/ledger-evidence.csv) but have no ledger row. Only they may lack one; the sha256 is the reviewed file.

pinned_history.basis: PR #287: live write-path hotfix (audit F02, F11-F13). Applied to production ahead of the privacy release with its exact text: through Lovable's migration tool (drizzle ledger hash) or with the release ledger template (statements = the file text).
